title: Same product, different country
subtitle: What the recipe carries in one market and not in another. Both lists come from the companies' own published declarations.
nothingDiffers: The declarations we hold for {a} and {b} list the same additives and ingredients.
noDeclarations: We hold no ingredient declaration for {a} or {b} yet, so there is nothing to compare. That is a gap in our data, not a statement that the two are the same.
needTwoMarkets: We hold data for only one market for this item, so there is nothing to compare yet.
caution: A difference here is a difference in what each company chose to declare, which is not always the same thing as a difference in the recipe. Declaration rules differ by country.
